text: Enumerate and zip are the clean way to loop when you need more than one thing.
We've got three names and three matching ages in parallel lists.
Enumerate hands you the index and the value together on every pass.
And start equals one means you count from one, not zero — ideal for numbered output.
So you never write range len and index back into the list by hand.
Zip walks two sequences side by side, pairing them position by position.
Each pass unpacks straight into name and age, ready to use.
Zip stops at the shorter of the two, so it never runs off the end.
And wrapping zip in dict turns two parallel lists into one dictionary, instantly.
Names to ages, in a single readable line.
